blocks.en: Analysis and Regulatory Links

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何操作程序決定無塵室品質？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Do Operating Procedures Determine Cleanroom Quality?

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-5 的核心邏輯：無塵室設計再完美，若操作程序不當，潔淨度仍會崩潰。人員、設備、物料、清潔這四大動態因素，是無塵室在「operational state」（操作狀態）下污染的主要來源。
blocks.en: The core logic of ISO 14644-5: however perfect the cleanroom design, cleanliness will still collapse if operating procedures are inadequate. Personnel, equipment, materials, and cleaning are the four dynamic factors that are the main sources of contamination in a cleanroom in the "operational state".

blocks.zh: 靜態 (at-rest) ≠ 動態 (operational)：典型的無塵室在靜態時微粒數遠低於限值，但人員進入後微粒數可上升 10-100 倍
blocks.en: At-rest ≠ operational: in a typical cleanroom, particle counts at rest are far below the limits, but once people enter, particle counts can rise 10-100 times

blocks.zh: 法規機構（如 FDA、EMA）要求超越 ISO 14644-5 的最低要求，特別是無菌製藥環境
blocks.en: Regulators (such as FDA and EMA) require more than the minimum requirements of ISO 14644-5, particularly in sterile pharmaceutical environments

blocks.zh: 本標準為「general operating standard」——不針對特定行業，是所有無塵室的基礎框架
blocks.en: This standard is a "general operating standard": it is not specific to any industry and is the foundational framework for all cleanrooms

blocks.zh: 比喻：無塵室如同手術室
blocks.en: Analogy: a cleanroom is like an operating room

blocks.zh: 醫院手術室設計再先進（負壓、HEPA、不鏽鋼牆面），若外科醫生不洗手、護士穿街服進入、設備帶菌進場，手術感染率仍會飆升。ISO 14644-5 就是「手術室操作規範」——規定人、衣、物、清潔的每一個動作。
blocks.en: However advanced a hospital operating room is (negative pressure, HEPA, stainless steel walls), surgical infection rates will still soar if surgeons do not scrub, nurses enter in street clothes, or equipment brings in bacteria. ISO 14644-5 is the "operating room code of practice": it specifies every action concerning people, clothing, materials, and cleaning.

blocks.zh: 法規重點：ISO 14644-5 vs. EU GMP Annex 1
blocks.en: Regulatory Focus: ISO 14644-5 vs. EU GMP Annex 1

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-5 是通用標準，EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 是製藥無菌製造的強制規範。兩者的關係：
blocks.en: ISO 14644-5 is a general standard, while EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) is the mandatory requirement for sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing. The relationship between the two:

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 第 4 節「人員」直接對應本標準 Section 4.3
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 Section 4 "Personnel" corresponds directly to Section 4.3 of this standard

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 第 9 節「環境監測」對應本標準 Section 4.1.2（風險監測）
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 Section 9 "Environmental Monitoring" corresponds to Section 4.1.2 of this standard (risk monitoring)

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 對 Grade A 的要求 遠嚴於 ISO 14644-5 的基本要求
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 requirements for Grade A are far stricter than the basic requirements of ISO 14644-5

blocks.zh: FDA Aseptic Processing Guide (2004) 第 IV 節人員要求與本標準高度對應
blocks.en: Section IV (Personnel) of the FDA Aseptic Processing Guide (2004) corresponds closely to this standard

blocks.en: Discussion Questions

blocks.zh: Q1： ISO 14644-5:2004 涵蓋哪些操作面向？請列舉六大類並說明各自的重要性。
blocks.en: Q1: Which operational aspects does ISO 14644-5:2004 cover? List the six categories and explain the importance of each.

blocks.zh: Q2： 為何本標準說「operational procedures have a profound effect」？舉例說明同一無塵室在靜態與動態時潔淨度的差異。
blocks.en: Q2: Why does this standard say that "operational procedures have a profound effect"? Give an example of the difference in cleanliness of the same cleanroom at rest and in operation.

blocks.zh: Q3： ISO 14644-5 與 EU GMP Annex 1 的關係如何？後者在哪些方面超越了前者的要求？
blocks.en: Q3: How does ISO 14644-5 relate to EU GMP Annex 1? In which respects does the latter go beyond the requirements of the former?

blocks.zh: Section 3 — Terms and Definitions 術語與定義
blocks.en: Section 3 - Terms and Definitions

blocks.zh: 術語解析 — 繁體中文詮釋
blocks.en: Terminology Analysis: Commentary

blocks.zh: 三種佔用狀態（Occupancy States）— 監測與驗證的核心概念
blocks.en: The Three Occupancy States: Core Concepts for Monitoring and Qualification

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-1 定義三種狀態，各有不同的粒子允許濃度：
blocks.en: ISO 14644-1 defines three states, each with different permissible particle concentrations:

blocks.zh: As-built（竣工狀態）：無設備、無人員；最乾淨，用於驗收測試
blocks.en: As-built: no equipment, no personnel; the cleanest state, used for acceptance testing

blocks.zh: At-rest（靜態）：設備安裝運轉，無操作人員；EU GMP 的靜態標準
blocks.en: At-rest: equipment installed and running, no operating personnel; the EU GMP at-rest standard

blocks.zh: Operational（動態）：正常生產中，有人員操作；EU GMP 的動態標準（最嚴格）
blocks.en: Operational: normal production with personnel working; the EU GMP in-operation standard (the strictest)

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 Grade A 要求：動態微粒 ≥ 0.5 µm 的限值為 3,520 /m³（等同 ISO Class 5 at-rest and operational）
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 Grade A requirement: the in-operation limit for particles ≥ 0.5 µm is 3,520 /m³ (equivalent to ISO Class 5 at-rest and operational)

blocks.zh: 比喻：三種狀態如同餐廳的三種情境
blocks.en: Analogy: the three states are like three situations in a restaurant

blocks.zh: 「竣工」= 剛裝潢完畢，桌椅未擺放，最乾淨；「靜態」= 桌椅就緒但未開門迎客；「動態」= 餐廳正在營業，廚師、服務員全到位。每種情境下的「髒亂程度」完全不同，無塵室監測的意義也完全不同。
blocks.en: "As-built" = just finished fitting out, no tables or chairs placed, the cleanest; "at-rest" = tables and chairs in place but not yet open to customers; "operational" = the restaurant is open for business, with cooks and waiters all in place. The level of "mess" is completely different in each situation, and so is the meaning of cleanroom monitoring.

blocks.zh: cross-over bench 的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of the Cross-Over Bench

blocks.zh: 跨越凳（cross-over bench）是更衣室設計的核心元件。其功能是建立「清潔側」與「污染側」的物理邊界：
blocks.en: The cross-over bench is the core element of changing room design. Its function is to establish a physical boundary between the "clean side" and the "contaminated side":

blocks.zh: 跨越凳前（污染側）：脫下街鞋或一般鞋套
blocks.en: Before the bench (contaminated side): remove street shoes or ordinary shoe covers

blocks.zh: 跨越凳後（清潔側）：穿上無塵室專用鞋或鞋套
blocks.en: After the bench (clean side): put on cleanroom-dedicated shoes or shoe covers

blocks.zh: 防止地板攜帶的污染跟入更衣室清潔側
blocks.en: Prevents contamination carried on the floor from following people into the clean side of the changing room

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 要求 Grade B/A 更衣區必須有足夠的設計隔離污染傳遞
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 requires that Grade B/A changing areas be designed with adequate segregation to prevent contamination transfer

blocks.zh: Q1： 「disinfection」與「sterilization」的本質差異為何？在 biocleanroom 中，兩者各在哪些場合使用？
blocks.en: Q1: What is the essential difference between "disinfection" and "sterilization"? In a biocleanroom, where is each used?

blocks.zh: Q2： 請解釋為何無塵室認證通常在「at-rest」狀態進行，但法規關注的是「operational」狀態的數據？
blocks.en: Q2: Explain why cleanroom certification is usually performed in the "at-rest" state, while regulators focus on data from the "operational" state.

blocks.zh: Q3： 在 Grade A 填充操作中，separative device（如隔離器）如何幫助減少對 operator 更衣等級的依賴？
blocks.en: Q3: In a Grade A filling operation, how does a separative device (such as an isolator) help reduce reliance on the operator's gowning grade?

blocks.zh: Section 4.1 — Operational Systems 操作系統規範
blocks.en: Section 4.1 - Operational Systems

blocks.zh: 4.1 的系統架構：SOP體系的四大支柱
blocks.en: Architecture of 4.1: The Four Pillars of the SOP System

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-5 Section 4.1 要求建立的不只是「幾份SOP」，而是一個完整的操作管理體系，包含：
blocks.en: What ISO 14644-5 Section 4.1 requires is not just "a few SOPs" but a complete operational management system, including:

blocks.zh: 文件化（4.1.1）：所有操作程序必須書面化，建立SOP架構
blocks.en: Documentation (4.1.1): all operating procedures must be written down and an SOP structure established

blocks.zh: 風險管理（4.1.2）：識別污染風險點，建立監測與行動計畫
blocks.en: Risk management (4.1.2): identify contamination risk points and establish monitoring and action plans

blocks.zh: 培訓體系（4.1.3/4.1.4）：系統性培訓並以文件佐證合格性
blocks.en: Training system (4.1.3/4.1.4): systematic training, with documentation to evidence competence

blocks.zh: 變更控制（4.1.6）：任何重大變更需重新驗證
blocks.en: Change control (4.1.6): any significant change requires revalidation

blocks.zh: 法規對應：EU GMP Annex 1 第 4 節（人員與培訓）
blocks.en: Regulatory Correspondence: EU GMP Annex 1 Section 4 (Personnel and Training)

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 第 4.1-4.10 條的要求直接對應 ISO 14644-5 的 Section 4.1：
blocks.en: The requirements of EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) clauses 4.1-4.10 correspond directly to Section 4.1 of ISO 14644-5:

blocks.zh: 4.1.2 風險監測 → EU GMP Annex 1 第 9 節：所有無菌製造區域必須有完整的環境監測程序（EM Programme），包括粒子與微生物
blocks.en: 4.1.2 Risk monitoring → EU GMP Annex 1 Section 9: all sterile manufacturing areas must have a complete environmental monitoring programme (EM Programme), covering both particles and microorganisms

blocks.zh: 4.1.3 培訓 → EU GMP Annex 1 §4.2：培訓必須包含微生物汙染控制原則；§4.3：培訓紀錄需保存
blocks.en: 4.1.3 Training → EU GMP Annex 1 §4.2: training must include the principles of microbiological contamination control; §4.3: training records must be retained

blocks.zh: 4.1.6 變更控制 → EU GMP Annex 1 §4.8：任何可能影響潔淨室分類的變更，需重新執行相關測試（requalification）
blocks.en: 4.1.6 Change control → EU GMP Annex 1 §4.8: any change that may affect cleanroom classification requires the relevant tests to be repeated (requalification)

blocks.zh: FDA Aseptic Processing Guide (2004) p.12-13：Personnel SOP 必須覆蓋更衣、行為規範、培訓認證
blocks.en: FDA Aseptic Processing Guide (2004) p.12-13: the personnel SOP must cover gowning, behavioral rules, and training and certification

blocks.zh: 風險評估工具（ISO 14644-5 Annex A.2.1 提及）
blocks.en: Risk Assessment Tools (mentioned in ISO 14644-5 Annex A.2.1)

blocks.zh:
污染風險評估三維度（A.2.2.1）：
1. 污染濃度（Concentration of contamination）
   — 污染源的濃度/量
2. 距離（Distance from risk to product）
   — 污染源離產品的距離
3. 防護強度（Protection method importance）
   — 隔離/屏蔽措施的有效性

風險分析工具（A.2.1）：
• HACCP — 危害分析關鍵管制點
• FMEA  — 失效模式與影響分析
• FTA   — 故障樹分析
blocks.en:
Three dimensions of contamination risk assessment (A.2.2.1):
1. Concentration of contamination
   - the concentration/amount of the contamination source
2. Distance from risk to product
   - the distance of the contamination source from the product
3. Protection method importance
   - the effectiveness of isolation/shielding measures

Risk analysis tools (A.2.1):
• HACCP - Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points
• FMEA  - Failure Mode and Effects Analysis
• FTA   - Fault Tree Analysis

blocks.zh: 製藥業通常以 FMEA 或 Risk Matrix 評估無塵室污染風險，結果需記錄並作為 EM Programme 設計的依據。
blocks.en: The pharmaceutical industry usually assesses cleanroom contamination risk with FMEA or a risk matrix; the results must be documented and used as the basis for designing the EM Programme.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用情境：接新案的操作系統建立
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Establishing the Operational Systems for a New Project

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 接到一個客戶的 Grade A 填充案，產品為注射劑（mAb）。根據 ISO 14644-5 Section 4.1，應如何建立操作系統？
blocks.en: Your CDMO has received a Grade A filling project from a client, for an injectable product (mAb). According to ISO 14644-5 Section 4.1, how should the operational systems be established?

blocks.zh: 4.1.1 文件架構：建立 SOP 目錄，涵蓋更衣、進出場、清潔、EM、設備維護等所有程序
blocks.en: 4.1.1 Documentation structure: build an SOP catalogue covering all procedures, including gowning, entry/exit, cleaning, EM, and equipment maintenance

blocks.zh: 4.1.2 風險識別：執行 FMEA，識別填充關鍵區域的污染風險（人員位置、設備表面、物料進場路徑）
blocks.en: 4.1.2 Risk identification: perform an FMEA to identify contamination risks in the critical filling area (personnel positions, equipment surfaces, material entry routes)

blocks.zh: 4.1.3/4.1.4 培訓：對所有將進入無菌區的人員進行分級培訓，保留培訓記錄、gowning qualification 記錄
blocks.en: 4.1.3/4.1.4 Training: provide graded training to all personnel who will enter the aseptic area, and retain training records and gowning qualification records

blocks.zh: 4.1.6 變更控制：建立 Change Control 程序，任何設備、SOP、人員的重大變更需走審查流程
blocks.en: 4.1.6 Change control: establish a Change Control procedure; any significant change to equipment, SOPs, or personnel must go through a review process

blocks.zh: Q1： 4.1.2 要求識別「risk factors」並建立監測方法。請列出製藥無菌填充操作的五個主要污染風險因子。
blocks.en: Q1: 4.1.2 requires identifying "risk factors" and establishing monitoring methods. List five major contamination risk factors in a pharmaceutical aseptic filling operation.

blocks.zh: Q2： 4.1.6 的「change of operational use」何時需要觸發 re-qualification？請舉兩個具體例子。
blocks.en: Q2: When does a "change of operational use" under 4.1.6 trigger requalification? Give two specific examples.

blocks.zh: Section 4.2 — Cleanroom Clothing 無塵室服裝
blocks.en: Section 4.2 - Cleanroom Clothing

blocks.zh: 無塵室服裝的核心功能：人體污染的「過濾器」
blocks.en: The Core Function of Cleanroom Clothing: A "Filter" for Human Contamination

blocks.zh: 人體是無塵室中最大的污染源：
blocks.en: The human body is the largest source of contamination in a cleanroom:

blocks.zh: 靜止狀態：每分鐘約散發 10萬 個微粒 (≥0.3µm)
blocks.en: At rest: about 100,000 particles per minute (≥0.3 µm)

blocks.zh: 正常行走：每分鐘約散發 500萬 個微粒
blocks.en: Normal walking: about 5 million particles per minute

blocks.zh: 快速走動：可達每分鐘 1,000萬 個微粒
blocks.en: Fast walking: up to 10 million particles per minute

blocks.zh: 細菌：每分鐘約散發數百個攜菌微粒（主要來自皮膚脫屑）
blocks.en: Bacteria: hundreds of microorganism-carrying particles per minute (mainly from skin flakes)

blocks.zh: 無塵室服裝的設計目標：攔截這些污染，使其不能進入環境。4.2.1 強調的「barrier fabric」就是這個原則的體現。
blocks.en: The design goal of cleanroom clothing is to intercept this contamination so that it cannot enter the environment. The "barrier fabric" emphasized in 4.2.1 embodies this principle.

blocks.zh: 比喻：無塵室服裝如同 N95 口罩的全身版
blocks.en: Analogy: cleanroom clothing is a full-body version of an N95 mask

blocks.zh: N95 口罩過濾鼻口呼出的顆粒；無塵室服裝則是全身「N95」——攔截皮膚、頭髮、衣物纖維等散發的污染物。材質越緊密（weave tightness 越高），過濾效率越好，但舒適度也越差（4.2.11 的 comfort 考量）。這是一個永遠需要平衡的取捨。
blocks.en: An N95 mask filters particles exhaled from the nose and mouth; cleanroom clothing is a full-body "N95" that intercepts contaminants shed from skin, hair, and clothing fibers. The tighter the material (the higher the weave tightness), the better the filtration efficiency, but the lower the comfort (the comfort consideration in 4.2.11). This is a trade-off that always has to be balanced.

blocks.zh: 法規連結：EU GMP Annex 1 更衣要求
blocks.en: Regulatory Link: EU GMP Annex 1 Gowning Requirements

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 對無菌製造區域服裝有明確要求：
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) sets clear requirements for clothing in sterile manufacturing areas:

blocks.zh: Grade A/B：連身工作服（coverall）、頭罩（hood）、面罩（face mask）、護目鏡（goggles）、連體靴（overboots）、兩層無粉手套；連身服需滅菌（sterilized）
blocks.en: Grade A/B: coverall, hood, face mask, goggles, overboots, and two layers of powder-free gloves; the coverall must be sterilized

blocks.zh: Grade C：髮帽、連身服或上衣 + 褲子、適當的鞋套；無需滅菌，但需消毒
blocks.en: Grade C: hair cover, coverall or jacket + trousers, and appropriate shoe covers; sterilization is not required, but disinfection is

blocks.zh: Grade D：基本無塵室服裝，包括髮帽
blocks.en: Grade D: basic cleanroom clothing, including a hair cover

blocks.zh: FDA Aseptic Guide §IV.A：Grade A/B 相當區域的更衣需「gown qualification」確認每個人員的更衣程序能達到微生物控制要求
blocks.en: FDA Aseptic Guide §IV.A: gowning for areas equivalent to Grade A/B requires "gown qualification" to confirm that each person's gowning procedure achieves the required microbial control

blocks.zh: 服裝品質驗證指標
blocks.en: Garment Quality Verification Indicators

blocks.zh:
服裝材質關鍵測試（Annex B.3）：
• Air permeability test（透氣性）
  → 越低 = 過濾效率越高，但舒適度越低
• Particle retention test（微粒截留率）
• Pore size measurement（孔徑）
• Electrostatic properties（靜電特性）
  → 半導體廠必測項目
• Durability test（耐用性）
  → 測試多次洗滌後的性能退化

Dispersal Chamber（Body Box）測試：
• 人員穿著服裝在密閉箱中運動
• 測量散發的微粒/細菌數
• 比較不同服裝的過濾效果
blocks.en:
Key garment material tests (Annex B.3):
• Air permeability test
  → the lower the permeability, the higher the filtration efficiency, but the lower the comfort
• Particle retention test
• Pore size measurement
• Electrostatic properties
  → a mandatory test item for semiconductor plants
• Durability test
  → tests performance degradation after repeated laundering

Dispersal chamber (body box) test:
• The person wears the garment and moves inside a closed box
• The number of particles/bacteria shed is measured
• The filtration performance of different garments is compared

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用情境：更衣 SOP 與服裝管理系統設計
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Designing the Gowning SOP and Garment Management System

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 接到 Grade A 填充案，請問更衣程序與服裝系統應如何設計？（依 4.2 全條文規劃）
blocks.en: Your CDMO has received a Grade A filling project. How should the gowning procedure and garment system be designed? (Plan according to all clauses of 4.2.)

blocks.zh: 4.2.1 材質選擇：Grade A/B 選用可高壓滅菌的連身服（如 Tyvek 或合成纖維覆膜材料），Grade C/D 選可清洗的合成纖維服
blocks.en: 4.2.1 Material selection: for Grade A/B, use autoclavable coveralls (such as Tyvek or laminated synthetic materials); for Grade C/D, use washable synthetic garments

blocks.zh: 4.2.3 更衣頻率：每次進入 Grade A/B 區需全套換新（或已滅菌）服裝；Grade C 可每班一次，但需視污染風險調整
blocks.en: 4.2.3 Change frequency: a complete new (or sterilized) set of garments for every entry into a Grade A/B area; Grade C may be once per shift, adjusted according to contamination risk

blocks.zh: 4.2.4/4.2.5 洗滌流程：建立外包洗滌商資格審核，要求提供洗滌驗證報告；Grade A/B 服裝洗滌後需重新滅菌並有效期管理
blocks.en: 4.2.4/4.2.5 Laundering process: establish a qualification review of the outsourced laundry provider and require laundering validation reports; Grade A/B garments must be re-sterilized after laundering and managed with an expiry period

blocks.zh: 4.2.10 定期檢查：建立服裝目視/微粒篩選程序，確認破損、磨損的服裝立即報廢
blocks.en: 4.2.10 Periodic inspection: establish a visual/particle screening procedure for garments; damaged or worn garments are scrapped immediately

blocks.zh: 4.2.6/4.2.7 儲存：在更衣室附近建立專用服裝儲存室，清潔服裝以獨立清潔袋封裝
blocks.en: 4.2.6/4.2.7 Storage: set up a dedicated garment storage room near the changing room, with clean garments packed in separate clean bags

blocks.zh: Q1： 為何 4.2.2 強調服裝必須「resist breakdown (minimal linting)」？天然棉質服裝為何不適合用於高等級無塵室？
blocks.en: Q1: Why does 4.2.2 stress that garments must "resist breakdown (minimal linting)"? Why are natural cotton garments unsuitable for high-grade cleanrooms?

blocks.zh: Q2： 4.2.10 要求「定期檢查」服裝。請設計一個簡單的服裝品質確認程序，包括哪些檢查項目？頻率如何定？
blocks.en: Q2: 4.2.10 requires "periodic inspection" of garments. Design a simple garment quality check procedure: which inspection items should it include, and how should the frequency be determined?

blocks.zh: Q3： 4.2.11 的 comfort 考量為何重要？不舒適的服裝會如何影響無塵室污染控制？
blocks.en: Q3: Why is the comfort consideration in 4.2.11 important? How would uncomfortable garments affect cleanroom contamination control?

blocks.zh: Section 4.3 — Personnel 人員管理
blocks.en: Section 4.3 - Personnel

blocks.zh: 人員：無塵室最難控制的污染源
blocks.en: Personnel: The Hardest Source of Contamination to Control in a Cleanroom

blocks.zh: Section 4.3 看似簡短（只有五條），但背後的原則極為重要：
blocks.en: Section 4.3 looks brief (only five clauses), but the principles behind it are extremely important:

blocks.zh: 4.3.1 個人物品（手機、鑰匙、錢包）帶入無塵室是嚴重的違規行為，這些物品表面的微粒和微生物難以控制
blocks.en: 4.3.1 Bringing personal items (mobile phones, keys, wallets) into the cleanroom is a serious violation, because the particles and microorganisms on their surfaces are difficult to control

blocks.zh: 4.3.3 珠寶政策：戒指、手錶可能刺穿手套、在袖口外露，增加微粒和微生物風險；此條要求建立明確的珠寶禁用政策
blocks.en: 4.3.3 Jewelry policy: rings and watches may puncture gloves or protrude from the cuffs, increasing particle and microbial risk; this clause requires a clear jewelry prohibition policy

blocks.zh: 4.3.4 行為訓練是核心：人員的每一個動作都可能增加微粒散發（快速走動、俯身、打噴嚏等）
blocks.en: 4.3.4 Behavioral training is central: every movement a person makes can increase particle shedding (fast walking, bending over, sneezing, etc.)

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 §4 人員要求精要
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 §4 Personnel Requirements in Brief

blocks.zh: §4.2：進入無菌區的人員需定期接受微生物污染控制和更衣程序的培訓
blocks.en: §4.2: personnel entering aseptic areas must receive regular training in microbiological contamination control and gowning procedures

blocks.zh: §4.4：有傷口、皮膚感染、感冒的人員不得進入 Grade A/B 區
blocks.en: §4.4: personnel with wounds, skin infections, or colds must not enter Grade A/B areas

blocks.zh: §4.5：禁止佩戴珠寶、假睫毛、塗指甲油等
blocks.en: §4.5: jewelry, false eyelashes, nail polish, etc. are prohibited

blocks.zh: §4.6：禁止在無菌區抓撓皮膚、觸摸臉部
blocks.en: §4.6: scratching the skin or touching the face in the aseptic area is prohibited

blocks.zh: §4.9：每年需進行 gowning qualification（微生物更衣資格確認），確認更衣後的微生物監測結果在限值內
blocks.en: §4.9: gowning qualification (microbiological confirmation of gowning) must be performed annually to confirm that the microbial monitoring results after gowning are within limits

blocks.zh: FDA Aseptic Guide §IV.A：人員必須接受非同步培訓（didactic training）和實際操作培訓，並有合格認證記錄
blocks.en: FDA Aseptic Guide §IV.A: personnel must receive both didactic training and hands-on training, with documented records of qualification

blocks.zh: 人員污染產生量的量化概念
blocks.en: Quantifying Contamination Generated by Personnel

blocks.zh:
人體粒子散發速率（參考值，Annex B.1）：
• 靜止站立：   ~100,000 顆/min (≥0.3µm)
• 正常步行：   ~500,000 顆/min
• 快速步行：  ~1,000,000 顆/min (100萬/min)
• 打噴嚏：    >100,000 顆/噴

攜菌微粒散發（人員在更衣服裝內）：
• 無塵室服裝：~10-100 CFU/min（依服裝設計和個人）
• 普通服裝：  ~1,000-10,000 CFU/min

結論：穿著合格無塵室服裝可將攜菌微粒降低
約 100-1000 倍，但仍無法降至零
blocks.en:
Human particle shedding rates (reference values, Annex B.1):
• Standing still:   ~100,000 particles/min (≥0.3 µm)
• Normal walking:   ~500,000 particles/min
• Fast walking:  ~1,000,000 particles/min (1 million/min)
• Sneezing:    >100,000 particles/sneeze

Shedding of microorganism-carrying particles (person inside gowning):
• Cleanroom clothing: ~10-100 CFU/min (depending on garment design and the individual)
• Ordinary clothing:  ~1,000-10,000 CFU/min

Conclusion: wearing qualified cleanroom clothing can reduce
microorganism-carrying particles by about 100-1000 times, but cannot bring them to zero

blocks.zh: Q1： 一個員工今天感冒、有輕微流鼻水，是否可以進入 Grade B 區工作？依據 ISO 14644-5 和 EU GMP Annex 1 各如何規範？
blocks.en: Q1: An employee has a cold today with a mild runny nose. May they work in a Grade B area? How do ISO 14644-5 and EU GMP Annex 1 each regulate this?

blocks.zh: Q2： EU GMP Annex 1 §4.9 的 gowning qualification 是什麼？請說明其目的、頻率和合格標準。
blocks.en: Q2: What is gowning qualification under EU GMP Annex 1 §4.9? Explain its purpose, frequency, and acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: Section 4.4 — Stationary Equipment 靜止設備
blocks.en: Section 4.4 - Stationary Equipment

blocks.zh: 靜止設備的污染風險與控制
blocks.en: Contamination Risks and Controls for Stationary Equipment

blocks.zh: 靜止設備（填充機、凍乾機、傳送帶、壓縮空氣系統等）是無塵室中的固定污染源管理重點：
blocks.en: Stationary equipment (filling machines, freeze dryers, conveyors, compressed air systems, etc.) is a key focus for managing fixed sources of contamination in a cleanroom:

blocks.zh: 進場污染（4.4.1/4.4.2）：設備在工廠外製造，表面帶有大量外部環境污染
blocks.en: Entry contamination (4.4.1/4.4.2): the equipment is manufactured outside the facility, and its surfaces carry a large amount of external environmental contamination

blocks.zh: 安裝污染（4.4.3）：安裝過程（焊接、鑽孔、鎖螺絲）產生大量微粒和金屬屑
blocks.en: Installation contamination (4.4.3): the installation process (welding, drilling, screwing) generates large amounts of particles and metal shavings

blocks.zh: 使用後污染（4.4.4/4.4.6）：設備老化、磨損、潤滑油洩漏等都是潛在污染源
blocks.en: Post-use contamination (4.4.4/4.4.6): equipment ageing, wear, and lubricant leaks are all potential contamination sources

blocks.zh: 4.4.6 的「preventive maintenance」是關鍵——在零件成為污染源前就更換，而非等到故障。
blocks.en: The "preventive maintenance" in 4.4.6 is key: replace parts before they become a source of contamination, rather than waiting for failure.

blocks.zh: 比喻：設備進場如同手術器械的滅菌管理
blocks.en: Analogy: equipment entry is like sterilization management of surgical instruments

blocks.zh: 未滅菌的手術器械進入手術室 = 大型設備未清潔進入無塵室。兩者都需要「進場前處理」（分層拆包 + 清潔/消毒）。大型設備因為體積龐大，需要在「移行室」（transfer room）分層處理，就像手術器械在消毒室（CSSD）逐步包裝處理一樣。
blocks.en: Unsterilized surgical instruments entering the operating room = large equipment entering the cleanroom without cleaning. Both need "pre-entry treatment" (layered unpacking + cleaning/disinfection). Because large equipment is bulky, it must be processed layer by layer in a "transfer room", just as surgical instruments are packaged and processed step by step in the sterile processing department (CSSD).

blocks.zh: 設備進場的關鍵原則（配合 Annex D）
blocks.en: Key Principles for Equipment Entry (with Annex D)

blocks.zh: 先拆外包裝（紙箱/木條）於非管制區，再帶入 Transfer Area
blocks.en: Remove the outer packaging first (cartons/wooden battens) in an uncontrolled area, then bring the equipment into the Transfer Area

blocks.zh: 分層清潔：在 Transfer Area 逐層擦拭（從上到下），去除表面污染
blocks.en: Layered cleaning: wipe layer by layer in the Transfer Area (from top to bottom) to remove surface contamination

blocks.zh: 正在生產的無塵室需特別保護（D.2.1）：對已在生產的無塵室，設備進場可能影響在製品，需制定隔離計畫
blocks.en: Cleanrooms already in production need special protection (D.2.1): for a cleanroom already in production, equipment entry may affect work in progress, so an isolation plan must be developed

blocks.zh: 安裝期間隔離（D.4）：大型設備安裝需搭建臨時隔離牆（temporary isolation wall），維持負壓防止污染擴散到鄰近無塵室
blocks.en: Isolation during installation (D.4): installation of large equipment requires a temporary isolation wall, maintaining negative pressure to prevent contamination from spreading to adjacent cleanrooms

blocks.zh: Q1： 一台新的填充機需要安裝在正在生產的 Grade B 無菌填充室旁。依 ISO 14644-5 Section 4.4 和 Annex D，應如何規劃安裝程序？
blocks.en: Q1: A new filling machine is to be installed next to a Grade B aseptic filling room that is in production. How should the installation procedure be planned under ISO 14644-5 Section 4.4 and Annex D?

blocks.zh: Q2： 「preventive maintenance」的概念與「corrective maintenance（故障維修）」有何本質差異？為何 4.4.6 特別強調 preventive maintenance schedule？
blocks.en: Q2: What is the essential difference between "preventive maintenance" and "corrective maintenance" (repair after failure)? Why does 4.4.6 specifically stress a preventive maintenance schedule?

blocks.zh: Section 4.5 — Materials and Portable Equipment 物料與可攜式設備
blocks.en: Section 4.5 - Materials and Portable Equipment

blocks.zh: 物料管理的核心原則：最少量、最短時間、有效進場程序
blocks.en: Core Principles of Materials Management: Minimum Quantity, Minimum Time, Effective Entry Procedures

blocks.zh: Section 4.5 的三個核心原則：
blocks.en: The three core principles of Section 4.5:

blocks.zh: 相容性（4.5.1）：物料必須適合該等級的無塵室——不能帶紙箱入 Grade B，不能帶未清潔的工具入 Grade A
blocks.en: Compatibility (4.5.1): materials must be suitable for the cleanroom grade: no cartons into Grade B, no uncleaned tools into Grade A

blocks.zh: 最少化（4.5.3）：無塵室不是倉庫，每件物料都是潛在污染源，在製品/原料僅保存必要量
blocks.en: Minimization (4.5.3): a cleanroom is not a warehouse; every item of material is a potential contamination source, so keep only the necessary quantity of work-in-process/raw materials

blocks.zh: 廢棄物及時移除（4.5.5）：廢棄物是已確定的污染源，不得在無塵室堆積
blocks.en: Prompt waste removal (4.5.5): waste is an established source of contamination and must not accumulate in the cleanroom

blocks.zh: 比喻：無塵室物料管理如同 ICU 病房的耗材管理
blocks.en: Analogy: cleanroom materials management is like consumables management in an ICU ward

blocks.zh: ICU 不允許在病床旁堆積未開封的醫療耗材；用過的耗材必須立即丟入感染廢棄物桶，而非堆在床邊。無塵室的物料管理原則完全相同——「just enough, just in time」，且廢棄物要頻繁移除。
blocks.en: An ICU does not allow unopened medical consumables to pile up beside the bed; used consumables must be thrown immediately into the infectious waste bin, not left at the bedside. The principles of cleanroom materials management are exactly the same: "just enough, just in time", with waste removed frequently.

blocks.zh: 物料進場程序的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of the Material Entry Procedure

blocks.zh: 4.5.2 要求建立物料進場程序。典型的雙層包裝進場流程（仿照 Annex E.4.1）：
blocks.en: 4.5.2 requires a material entry procedure to be established. A typical double-wrapped entry flow (modeled on Annex E.4.1):

blocks.zh: 在倉庫（非管制區）確認物料，移除紙箱/木棧板
blocks.en: In the warehouse (uncontrolled area), verify the materials and remove cartons/wooden pallets

blocks.zh: 在外部 Transfer Area：去除外層包裝（紙盒、泡棉），以濕擦布擦拭內層包裝外表面
blocks.en: In the external Transfer Area: remove the outer packaging (cartons, foam) and wipe the outer surface of the inner packaging with a damp wipe

blocks.zh: 在 Grade C/D 的 Transfer Area：剝除外層塑膠袋，以消毒劑擦拭內袋外表面，推入 Grade B 的氣閘
blocks.en: In the Grade C/D Transfer Area: strip off the outer plastic bag, wipe the outer surface of the inner bag with disinfectant, and pass it into the Grade B airlock

blocks.zh: Grade B 氣閘：移除最後一層包裝，物料可進入 Grade B 區使用
blocks.en: Grade B airlock: remove the last layer of packaging; the materials can then enter the Grade B area for use

blocks.zh: 此程序通常稱為「雙層去包法」（double-bag / triple-bag entry）。
blocks.en: This procedure is usually called the "double-bag / triple-bag entry" method.

blocks.zh: Q1： 4.5.3 要求「minimize the quantities of materials stored in the cleanroom」。請說明在無菌填充操作中，哪些物料不應在 Grade B 無塵室長期存放？
blocks.en: Q1: 4.5.3 requires "minimize the quantities of materials stored in the cleanroom". In an aseptic filling operation, which materials should not be stored in the Grade B cleanroom for long periods?

blocks.zh: Q2： 4.5.5 對廢棄物的要求如何？請說明廢棄物「removal procedures」設計時需考慮哪些因素？
blocks.en: Q2: What does 4.5.5 require for waste? What factors must be considered when designing waste "removal procedures"?

blocks.zh: Section 4.6 — Cleanroom Cleaning 無塵室清潔
blocks.en: Section 4.6 - Cleanroom Cleaning

blocks.zh: 清潔管理的六大要素（4.6 全條文）
blocks.en: The Six Elements of Cleaning Management (All Clauses of 4.6)

blocks.zh: 方法標準化（4.6.1）：SOP 需明確規定使用什麼清潔劑、什麼工具、如何擦拭
blocks.en: Standardized methods (4.6.1): the SOP must specify exactly which cleaning agents and tools to use and how to wipe

blocks.zh: 人員指定培訓（4.6.2）：清潔人員需接受專門培訓，不能隨便指派未受訓人員清潔
blocks.en: Designated trained personnel (4.6.2): cleaning personnel must receive dedicated training; untrained personnel must not be assigned to clean at random

blocks.zh: 頻率計畫（4.6.3）：建立清潔時程表，依表面關鍵性與污染速率定義頻率
blocks.en: Frequency plan (4.6.3): establish a cleaning schedule, defining frequency according to surface criticality and contamination rate

blocks.zh: 污染驗證（4.6.4）：清潔後需進行污染確認（粒子、微生物），確認清潔有效
blocks.en: Contamination verification (4.6.4): after cleaning, perform contamination checks (particles, microorganisms) to confirm that cleaning is effective

blocks.zh: 在製品保護（4.6.5）：清潔時必須移除或遮蓋在製品，防止清潔過程污染產品
blocks.en: Protection of work in process (4.6.5): work in process must be removed or covered during cleaning to prevent the cleaning process from contaminating the product

blocks.zh: 緊急清潔（4.6.6）：意外溢漏、污染事件的緊急應變清潔程序
blocks.en: Emergency cleaning (4.6.6): emergency response cleaning procedures for accidental spills and contamination events

blocks.zh: 法規連結：PDA TR70 與 EU GMP Annex 1
blocks.en: Regulatory Link: PDA TR70 and EU GMP Annex 1

blocks.zh: PDA Technical Report No. 70（Cleaning and Disinfection of Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Facilities）是最詳細的製藥清潔法規指南：
blocks.en: PDA Technical Report No. 70 (Cleaning and Disinfection of Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Facilities) is the most detailed guidance for pharmaceutical cleaning:

blocks.zh: 消毒劑輪替（Disinfectant Rotation）：至少兩種消毒劑輪替使用，防止微生物產生抗藥性
blocks.en: Disinfectant Rotation: rotate at least two disinfectants to prevent microorganisms from developing resistance

blocks.zh: 消毒劑效力驗證（Efficacy Testing）：需對廠內分離的微生物進行效力測試
blocks.en: Disinfectant Efficacy Testing: efficacy must be tested against microorganisms isolated in the facility

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證（Cleaning Validation）：證明清潔程序能持續達到預定的清潔標準
blocks.en: Cleaning Validation: demonstrate that the cleaning procedure consistently achieves the predetermined cleanliness standard

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 §4.34-4.36：清潔和消毒劑需定期確認其效力；消毒劑不得是微生物生長的來源（需有防腐劑或新鮮配製）。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 §4.34-4.36: the efficacy of cleaning agents and disinfectants must be confirmed regularly; disinfectants must not be a source of microbial growth (they need preservatives or must be freshly prepared).

blocks.zh: Q1： 4.6.5 要求在清潔前評估清潔操作對在製品的風險。請說明在 Grade A 填充操作期間，若需清潔相鄰的 Grade B 區域，應採取哪些保護措施？
blocks.en: Q1: 4.6.5 requires that the risk of cleaning operations to work in process be assessed before cleaning. During a Grade A filling operation, if an adjacent Grade B area must be cleaned, what protective measures should be taken?

blocks.zh: Q2： 依 4.6.6，請設計一個「溢漏事件（spill event）」的緊急清潔應變 SOP 框架，包含判斷流程和清潔步驟。
blocks.en: Q2: Under 4.6.6, design an emergency cleaning response SOP framework for a "spill event", including the decision flow and cleaning steps.

blocks.zh: Annex A (Informative) — Operational Systems 操作系統詳細指南
blocks.en: Annex A (Informative) - Operational Systems: Detailed Guidance

blocks.zh: Annex A 深度解析
blocks.en: Annex A In-Depth Analysis

blocks.zh: Annex A 的定位：將四條規範性要求轉化為管理體系
blocks.en: The Role of Annex A: Turning Normative Requirements into a Management System

blocks.zh: Section 4.1 只有七條簡短的規範性要求，Annex A 則提供了詳細的執行指南，從：
blocks.en: Section 4.1 has only seven short normative requirements, while Annex A provides detailed implementation guidance, ranging from:

blocks.zh: 風險評估方法論（HACCP/FMEA/FTA）
blocks.en: Risk assessment methodologies (HACCP/FMEA/FTA)

blocks.zh: 六大類污染風險因子的詳細清單
blocks.en: A detailed list of six categories of contamination risk factors

blocks.zh: 監測計畫設計（action level vs. alert level）
blocks.en: Monitoring program design (action level vs. alert level)

blocks.zh: 九個培訓對象類別與11個培訓課程主題
blocks.en: Nine categories of training audience and 11 training course topics

blocks.zh: 設施支援服務的文件要求
blocks.en: Documentation requirements for facility support services

blocks.zh: 變更控制與重新資格確認
blocks.en: Change control and requalification

blocks.zh: 安全管理計畫
blocks.en: Safety management program

blocks.zh: A.3 監測與糾正行動：Alert Level vs. Action Level
blocks.en: A.3 Monitoring and Corrective Action: Alert Level vs. Action Level

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 §9 建立了兩層監測限度的概念，與 A.3 高度對應：
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 §9 establishes the concept of two tiers of monitoring limits, which corresponds closely to A.3:

blocks.zh: Alert Level（警戒限度）：超出顯示可能偏離正常操作的早期警訊，需調查原因但不一定停止生產
blocks.en: Alert Level: an excursion is an early warning of a possible departure from normal operation; the cause must be investigated but production need not necessarily stop

blocks.zh: Action Level（行動限度）：超出時需立即採取行動，包括停止操作、調查、糾正
blocks.en: Action Level: an excursion requires immediate action, including stopping operations, investigation, and correction

blocks.zh: 兩者都需在 EM SOP 中以書面定義，且需基於趨勢分析和驗證數據設定
blocks.en: Both must be defined in writing in the EM SOP and set on the basis of trend analysis and qualification data

blocks.zh: 超出 Action Level 的事件需啟動 OOS/OOT 調查程序
blocks.en: An event exceeding the Action Level must trigger the OOS/OOT investigation procedure

blocks.zh: A.4 培訓體系：製藥業的 GMP 培訓架構
blocks.en: A.4 Training System: The GMP Training Structure in the Pharmaceutical Industry

blocks.zh: A.4 提出的培訓體系對應 EU GMP Part 1 第 2 章「人員」和 ICH Q10 的人員管理要求：
blocks.en: The training system proposed in A.4 corresponds to EU GMP Part 1 Chapter 2 "Personnel" and the personnel management requirements of ICH Q10:

blocks.zh: 培訓課程設計（A.4.2）：11項主題涵蓋理論（cleanroom science）和操作（gowning, cleaning, behavior）
blocks.en: Training course design (A.4.2): 11 topics covering theory (cleanroom science) and practice (gowning, cleaning, behavior)

blocks.zh: 認證制度（A.4.1）：培訓後需通過測試才算合格；不只是「上課打卡」
blocks.en: Certification system (A.4.1): after training, personnel must pass a test to be deemed qualified; it is not just "attending class and signing in"

blocks.zh: 行為監測（A.4.3）：訓練後仍需持續觀察人員行為，建立稽核機制
blocks.en: Behavior monitoring (A.4.3): after training, personnel behavior must continue to be observed and an audit mechanism established

blocks.zh: 文件管理（A.4.4）：每個人員的培訓歷程、認證日期、再培訓計畫需存檔
blocks.en: Document management (A.4.4): each person's training history, certification dates, and retraining plan must be filed

blocks.zh: 製藥廠通常使用培訓管理系統（如 Veeva Vault Training、ComplianceWire）管理這些記錄。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical plants usually use a training management system (such as Veeva Vault Training or ComplianceWire) to manage these records.

blocks.zh: 比喻：A.5 支援服務如同飛機的地勤系統
blocks.en: Analogy: A.5 support services are like an aircraft's ground crew system

blocks.zh: 飛機在地面的地勤服務（加油、機械檢查、清潔）決定了飛行安全；無塵室的「支援服務」（HVAC、壓縮空氣、純水、設備維護）決定了潔淨室能否正常運作。A.5 的文件要求（A.5.2-A.5.6）就是「地勤手冊」——確保每個支援系統都有操作指南、維護記錄和緊急應變程序。
blocks.en: Ground services for an aircraft (refueling, mechanical checks, cleaning) determine flight safety; the "support services" of a cleanroom (HVAC, compressed air, purified water, equipment maintenance) determine whether the cleanroom can operate normally. The documentation requirements of A.5 (A.5.2-A.5.6) are the "ground crew manual": making sure each support system has operating instructions, maintenance records, and emergency response procedures.

blocks.zh: A.6 變更控制：與 ICH Q10 和 GMP 的連結
blocks.en: A.6 Change Control: Links to ICH Q10 and GMP

blocks.zh: Annex A.6 的「upgrading and modifying」管理對應製藥業的 Change Control 系統：
blocks.en: The "upgrading and modifying" management in Annex A.6 corresponds to the pharmaceutical industry's Change Control system:

blocks.zh: 任何影響無塵室分類的變更都需重新資格確認（requalification）
blocks.en: Any change affecting cleanroom classification requires requalification

blocks.zh: 典型的 Change Control 觸發事件：更換 HEPA 過濾器型號、擴建無塵室空間、更換物料傳遞路徑、新增設備
blocks.en: Typical Change Control triggers: changing the HEPA filter model, expanding cleanroom space, changing the material transfer route, adding equipment

blocks.zh: EU GMP Part 1 §13：Change Control 需評估變更對產品品質的影響，並在實施前獲得 QA 批准
blocks.en: EU GMP Part 1 §13: Change Control must assess the impact of the change on product quality and obtain QA approval before implementation

blocks.zh: 重大變更可能需要補充臨床/分析性研究（Regulatory Filing）
blocks.en: Major changes may require supplementary clinical/analytical studies (Regulatory Filing)

blocks.zh: FMEA 在無塵室操作風險評估的應用
blocks.en: Application of FMEA to Cleanroom Operational Risk Assessment

blocks.zh:
FMEA 評估矩陣（Risk Priority Number, RPN）：
RPN = Severity (S) × Occurrence (O) × Detectability (D)

範例：Grade A 填充操作的 FMEA
┌────────────────────┬───┬───┬───┬─────┐
│ 失效模式           │ S │ O │ D │ RPN │
├────────────────────┼───┼───┼───┼─────┤
│ 操作員進入時未更衣  │ 9 │ 2 │ 3 │  54 │
│ 手套破損未發現     │ 9 │ 3 │ 6 │ 162 │
│ 填充針頭暴露時間>X  │ 8 │ 2 │ 4 │  64 │
│ HEPA 過濾器洩漏    │10 │ 1 │ 8 │  80 │
│ 清潔消毒程序跳步   │ 8 │ 2 │ 5 │  80 │
└────────────────────┴───┴───┴───┴─────┘

高 RPN 項目優先制定控制措施
（通常 RPN > 100 需要立即改善）
blocks.en:
FMEA assessment matrix (Risk Priority Number, RPN):
RPN = Severity (S) × Occurrence (O) × Detectability (D)

Example: FMEA for a Grade A filling operation
┌──────────────────────────────────────┬───┬───┬───┬─────┐
│ Failure mode                         │ S │ O │ D │ RPN │
├──────────────────────────────────────┼───┼───┼───┼─────┤
│ Operator enters without gowning      │ 9 │ 2 │ 3 │  54 │
│ Glove breach not detected            │ 9 │ 3 │ 6 │ 162 │
│ Filling needle exposure time >X      │ 8 │ 2 │ 4 │  64 │
│ HEPA filter leak                     │10 │ 1 │ 8 │  80 │
│ Cleaning/disinfection step skipped   │ 8 │ 2 │ 5 │  80 │
└──────────────────────────────────────┴───┴───┴───┴─────┘

High-RPN items get control measures first
(generally RPN > 100 requires immediate improvement)

blocks.zh: Q1： Annex A.4.3 建議對人員行為進行持續監測（如内部稽核）。請說明在日常無菌填充作業中，如何設計人員行為觀察計畫（behavior observation program）？
blocks.en: Q1: Annex A.4.3 recommends continuous monitoring of personnel behavior (such as internal audits). In routine aseptic filling operations, how should a behavior observation program be designed?

blocks.zh: Q2： A.3 提到 action level 和 alert level。如果無塵室的粒子計數連續三天超出 alert level 但未超出 action level，應採取哪些行動？
blocks.en: Q2: A.3 mentions action level and alert level. If cleanroom particle counts exceed the alert level for three consecutive days but do not exceed the action level, what actions should be taken?

blocks.zh: Q3： A.6 中列出了變更時需通知的人員清單（facility engineers, QA, contractors 等）。請說明為何「contamination control engineer」在無塵室變更評估中扮演關鍵角色？
blocks.en: Q3: A.6 lists the people to be notified of a change (facility engineers, QA, contractors, etc.). Explain why the "contamination control engineer" plays a key role in cleanroom change assessment.

blocks.zh: Annex B (Informative) — Cleanroom Clothing 無塵室服裝詳細指南
blocks.en: Annex B (Informative) - Cleanroom Clothing: Detailed Guidance

blocks.zh: Annex B 深度解析
blocks.en: Annex B In-Depth Analysis

blocks.zh: 服裝過濾機制：為何織物密度是關鍵？
blocks.en: Garment Filtration Mechanism: Why Is Fabric Density Critical?

blocks.zh: B.3.1 描述了無塵室服裝的過濾機制：
blocks.en: B.3.1 describes the filtration mechanism of cleanroom garments:

blocks.zh: 織物 = 過濾器：纖維之間的孔隙攔截皮膚脫落的角質細胞和微粒
blocks.en: Fabric = filter: the pores between fibers intercept skin squames and particles shed from the skin

blocks.zh: 孔隙越小 = 過濾效率越高，但相對地「泵吸效應（pumping action）」越強——肢體活動時服裝內壓增加，迫使未過濾空氣從領口、袖口溢出
blocks.en: The smaller the pores, the higher the filtration efficiency, but the stronger the "pumping action": when the limbs move, the pressure inside the garment rises, forcing unfiltered air out through the collar and cuffs

blocks.zh: 設計補償：好的更衣設計需在高效過濾和密封開口（領口、袖口、腳踝）之間取得平衡
blocks.en: Design compensation: good gown design must balance high-efficiency filtration against sealed openings (collar, cuffs, ankles)

blocks.zh: 服裝等級與製藥分級的對應關係
blocks.en: Correspondence Between Garment Grade and Pharmaceutical Grade

blocks.zh:
EU GMP 分級 vs. 服裝要求（Annex 1 2022）

Grade A/B 無菌核心區：
• 連身覆蓋式無塵服（全身覆蓋）
• 頭罩（完整覆蓋頭頸）
• 面罩（口鼻遮蔽）
• 護目鏡
• 無粉手套（2層，定期消毒）
• 無塵靴（連體靴）
• 服裝需滅菌（γ 照射或高壓蒸汽）

Grade C 支援區：
• 連身服或上衣+褲子
• 髮帽/頭罩
• 合適鞋套
• 服裝需清潔，消毒可選

Grade D 一般製藥區：
• 基本無塵服
• 髮帽
• 無特殊手套要求（視操作而定）

手套材質選擇考量（B.7）：
• 乳膠 Latex：高彈性，但過敏問題
• 丁腈 Nitrile：無過敏，耐化學品
• 聚氨酯 PU：薄型，高觸感，適合精細操作
• 乙烯 Vinyl：便宜，化學品保護較弱
blocks.en:
EU GMP grade vs. garment requirements (Annex 1, 2022)

Grade A/B aseptic core area:
• Full-coverage coverall (whole body)
• Hood (completely covering head and neck)
• Face mask (covering nose and mouth)
• Goggles
• Powder-free gloves (2 layers, disinfected regularly)
• Cleanroom boots (overboots)
• Garments must be sterilized (gamma irradiation or autoclave)

Grade C support area:
• Coverall or jacket + trousers
• Hair cover/hood
• Suitable shoe covers
• Garments must be cleaned; disinfection optional

Grade D general pharmaceutical area:
• Basic cleanroom garment
• Hair cover
• No special glove requirement (depends on the operation)

Glove material selection considerations (B.7):
• Latex: highly elastic, but allergy concerns
• Nitrile: non-allergenic, chemical resistant
• Polyurethane (PU): thin, high tactile sensitivity, suited to delicate operations
• Vinyl: inexpensive, weaker chemical protection

blocks.zh: 比喻：服裝洗滌如同手術器械再處理（Reprocessing）
blocks.en: Analogy: garment laundering is like reprocessing surgical instruments

blocks.zh: 重複使用的無塵室服裝，每次使用後都需要「再處理」（laundering + sterilization），就像手術器械必須清洗、消毒/滅菌才能再次使用。關鍵原則：洗滌機構的清潔環境必須與服裝使用環境相容（B.6）——就如手術器械必須在 CSSD 而非一般廁所清洗。
blocks.en: Reusable cleanroom garments need "reprocessing" (laundering + sterilization) after every use, just as surgical instruments must be cleaned and disinfected/sterilized before they can be used again. The key principle: the clean environment of the laundry facility must be compatible with the environment in which the garments are used (B.6), just as surgical instruments must be washed in the CSSD rather than in an ordinary restroom.

blocks.zh: B.4.3 Body Box 測試：服裝效能的黃金標準驗證
blocks.en: B.4.3 Body Box Test: The Gold Standard for Verifying Garment Performance

blocks.zh: Body Box（Dispersal Chamber）測試是目前最直接的服裝效能驗證方法：
blocks.en: The body box (dispersal chamber) test is currently the most direct method of verifying garment performance:

blocks.zh: 人員穿著待測服裝進入密閉測試箱
blocks.en: A person wearing the garment under test enters a closed test chamber

blocks.zh: 在過濾空氣（已知潔淨度）的箱體中執行標準動作（原地踏步、彎腰等）
blocks.en: Standard movements (marching on the spot, bending, etc.) are performed in a chamber supplied with filtered air (of known cleanliness)

blocks.zh: 箱體出口空氣以粒子計數器或微生物採樣器測量
blocks.en: The air leaving the chamber is measured with a particle counter or microbial sampler

blocks.zh: 可量化比較不同服裝的「屏蔽效率」
blocks.en: The "barrier efficiency" of different garments can be compared quantitatively

blocks.zh: FDA Aseptic Guide 建議用類似方法驗證 Grade A/B 服裝的屏蔽效能
blocks.en: The FDA Aseptic Guide recommends using a similar method to verify the barrier performance of Grade A/B garments

blocks.zh: 服裝儲存管理（B.9）的實務要點
blocks.en: Practical Points for Garment Storage Management (B.9)

blocks.zh: 滅菌服裝的效期管理（B.9.4）：γ照射或高壓蒸汽滅菌的服裝，必須有明確的「使用期限（shelf life）」，通常依包裝材質和儲存條件定（如真空包裝可達 6-12 個月）
blocks.en: Shelf-life management of sterilized garments (B.9.4): garments sterilized by gamma irradiation or autoclave must have a defined "shelf life", usually set according to packaging material and storage conditions (for example, vacuum packaging can last 6-12 months)

blocks.zh: 先進先出（FIFO）原則：庫存管理需確保舊服裝先用，避免超期
blocks.en: First-in, first-out (FIFO): inventory management must ensure that older garments are used first, to avoid expiry

blocks.zh: 儲存環境控制：建議在溫濕度受控的更衣室附近設置服裝存放區，避免服裝因環境影響（濕度、紫外線）而提前失效
blocks.en: Storage environment control: a garment storage area is recommended near the temperature- and humidity-controlled changing room, to prevent garments from failing prematurely due to environmental effects (humidity, ultraviolet light)

blocks.zh: 破損檢查（4.2.10）：每次使用前目視確認服裝完整性，破損服裝立即報廢
blocks.en: Damage inspection (4.2.10): visually check garment integrity before every use, and scrap damaged garments immediately

blocks.zh: Q1： 在 Grade A/B 無菌填充區，服裝的最重要屏障特性是什麼？為何「泵吸效應（pumping action）」可能抵消高密度織物的過濾效果？
blocks.en: Q1: In a Grade A/B aseptic filling area, what is the most important barrier property of garments? Why can "pumping action" cancel out the filtration benefit of a high-density fabric?

blocks.zh: Q2： 請設計一個「服裝外包洗滌商資格評估」的評估清單，包含哪些必要的技術和品質管理要求？
blocks.en: Q2: Design a checklist for "qualification assessment of an outsourced garment laundry provider". What technical and quality management requirements must it include?

blocks.zh: Q3： B.7 描述了多種手套材質。在細胞治療（Cell Therapy）的 Grade A 操作中，應優先考慮哪些手套特性？為什麼？
blocks.en: Q3: B.7 describes several glove materials. For Grade A operations in cell therapy, which glove characteristics should be prioritized, and why?

blocks.zh: Annex C (Informative) — Personnel 人員詳細指南
blocks.en: Annex C (Informative) - Personnel: Detailed Guidance

blocks.zh: Annex C 深度解析
blocks.en: Annex C In-Depth Analysis

blocks.zh: C.5 更衣程序的邏輯：從外到內、由上到下
blocks.en: The Logic of the C.5 Gowning Procedure: Outside to Inside, Top to Bottom

blocks.zh: C.5 的16步更衣程序遵循一個核心邏輯：最先接觸最乾淨的部分，最後接觸最可能被污染的部分。理解這個邏輯，就能理解每一步的順序原因：
blocks.en: The 16-step gowning procedure in C.5 follows one core logic: touch the cleanest parts first, and the parts most likely to be contaminated last. Once you understand this logic, you understand the reason for the order of each step:

blocks.zh: 第1步（清潔鞋底）：進入更衣室前先去除鞋底污染，防止污染傳入更衣室
blocks.en: Step 1 (clean shoe soles): remove contamination from the soles before entering the changing room, to prevent contamination being carried into it

blocks.zh: 第5步（先戴頭罩）：頭髮/頭皮是最難被服裝覆蓋的部位，優先處理
blocks.en: Step 5 (put on the hood first): hair and scalp are the hardest areas for garments to cover, so they are dealt with first

blocks.zh: 第13步（用 cross-over bench 穿鞋套）：跨越凳確保穿好鞋套的腳不會重新接觸「污染地面」
blocks.en: Step 13 (put on shoe covers using the cross-over bench): the cross-over bench ensures that feet already covered do not touch the "contaminated floor" again

blocks.zh: 第14步（全身鏡確認）：確認所有服裝密合，沒有暴露部位
blocks.en: Step 14 (full-length mirror check): confirm that all garments fit tightly and no skin is exposed

blocks.zh: C.6 行為規範：最容易被忽視的污染風險
blocks.en: C.6 Behavioral Rules: The Most Easily Overlooked Contamination Risk

blocks.zh: C.6 的行為規範直接對應 EU GMP Annex 1 §4.5-4.7 的要求，以下是製藥稽查員最常查到的違規行為：
blocks.en: The behavioral rules in C.6 correspond directly to the requirements of EU GMP Annex 1 §4.5-4.7. The following are the violations most often found by pharmaceutical inspectors:

blocks.zh: 人員站位錯誤：站在 HEPA 出風口與產品之間（污染產品），而非站在產品下游側
blocks.en: Incorrect personnel positioning: standing between the HEPA air supply and the product (contaminating the product), rather than downstream of the product

blocks.zh: 快速走動：破壞層流，使地板污染揚起到工作高度
blocks.en: Fast movement: disrupts laminar flow and lifts floor contamination up to working height

blocks.zh: 在無菌區說話：即使戴面罩，說話仍增加呼氣汙染物散發
blocks.en: Talking in the aseptic area: even with a face mask, talking still increases the shedding of exhaled contaminants

blocks.zh: 靠著設備/牆面：服裝外表面因接觸帶菌表面而污染
blocks.en: Leaning on equipment/walls: the outer surface of the garment becomes contaminated through contact with surfaces carrying microorganisms

blocks.zh: 手套未及時更換：接觸非無菌表面後繼續操作無菌物品
blocks.en: Gloves not changed promptly: continuing to handle sterile items after touching non-sterile surfaces

blocks.zh: FDA 483 常見觀察項目：人員在無菌區的行為不符合「aseptic technique」要求，是最常見的稽查缺失之一。
blocks.en: Common FDA 483 observation: personnel behavior in the aseptic area that does not meet "aseptic technique" requirements is one of the most common inspection deficiencies.

blocks.zh: 比喻：C.6 行為規範如同外科手術中的「無菌技術」
blocks.en: Analogy: C.6 behavioral rules are like "aseptic technique" in surgery

blocks.zh: 外科「無菌技術（aseptic technique）」的核心就是：永遠不要用已污染的手/器械接觸無菌區域。無塵室的 C.6 行為規範是相同邏輯的工業版——避免任何「污染傳遞路徑」（contamination transfer path）的形成。「No-touch technique」正是這個原則的體現。
blocks.en: The core of surgical "aseptic technique" is: never touch a sterile area with a contaminated hand or instrument. The C.6 behavioral rules are the industrial version of the same logic: avoid forming any "contamination transfer path". "No-touch technique" embodies exactly this principle.

blocks.zh: 人員污染貢獻量的量化監測（Gowning Qualification）
blocks.en: Quantitative Monitoring of Personnel Contamination Contribution (Gowning Qualification)

blocks.zh:
EU GMP Annex 1 §4.9 Gowning Qualification 流程：

1. 更衣程序：依 SOP 標準更衣程序完成更衣
2. 採樣點：手套（雙手指尖）+ 前胸（連身服表面）
3. 採樣方法：指尖接觸培養基 (5 fingers / hand)
              連身服表面 contact plate 或 swab
4. 合格標準（EU GMP Annex 1 Table 1）：
   • Grade A/B：≤ 1 CFU / contact plate
   • Grade C：≤ 25 CFU / contact plate
   • Grade D：≤ 50 CFU / contact plate
5. 執行頻率：初始認證 + 至少每年一次再確認
6. 不合格處理：重新培訓 → 重新測試 → 仍不合格需限制進入
blocks.en:
EU GMP Annex 1 §4.9 gowning qualification process:

1. Gowning: complete gowning following the standard SOP gowning procedure
2. Sampling sites: gloves (fingertips of both hands) + chest (coverall surface)
3. Sampling method: fingertips pressed onto culture medium (5 fingers / hand)
                     coverall surface by contact plate or swab
4. Acceptance criteria (EU GMP Annex 1 Table 1):
   • Grade A/B: ≤ 1 CFU / contact plate
   • Grade C: ≤ 25 CFU / contact plate
   • Grade D: ≤ 50 CFU / contact plate
5. Frequency: initial qualification + requalification at least once a year
6. Failure handling: retraining → retesting → access restricted if still failing

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用情境：新員工進入 Grade B 區的培訓資格確認計畫
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Training Qualification Plan for New Employees Entering a Grade B Area

blocks.zh: 請依 Annex C 設計新員工進入 Grade B 無菌填充區的培訓資格確認計畫：
blocks.en: Design a training qualification plan for new employees entering the Grade B aseptic filling area, according to Annex C:

blocks.zh: 培訓內容（C.1/A.4.2）：無塵室科學原理（2h）+ 無菌技術基礎（4h）+ 更衣SOP練習（2h）
blocks.en: Training content (C.1/A.4.2): cleanroom science principles (2 h) + aseptic technique fundamentals (4 h) + gowning SOP practice (2 h)

blocks.zh: 知識考試（A.4.1）：筆試 ≥ 80 分通過；未通過需重新培訓
blocks.en: Knowledge test (A.4.1): written test, pass mark ≥ 80; those who fail must be retrained

blocks.zh: 更衣資格確認（Gowning Qualification）：連續3次更衣後採樣，結果需符合 Grade B 標準（≤1 CFU）
blocks.en: Gowning qualification: sampling after 3 consecutive gowning events, with results meeting the Grade B standard (≤1 CFU)

blocks.zh: 行為監測（A.4.3）：進入無菌室前3個月由資深人員或QA人員觀察行為，記錄並提供回饋
blocks.en: Behavior monitoring (A.4.3): for the 3 months before entering the aseptic room, behavior is observed by senior personnel or QA, with records and feedback provided

blocks.zh: 年度再確認：每年重複 gowning qualification；重大違規後立即重新培訓
blocks.en: Annual requalification: repeat gowning qualification every year; retrain immediately after a major violation

blocks.zh: Q1： C.6 說明「Personnel should not position themselves between clean air supplies and product or process surfaces.」請解釋在單向氣流（LAF）工作站操作時，正確的人員站位原則，並說明為何違反此原則會造成污染。
blocks.en: Q1: C.6 states that "Personnel should not position themselves between clean air supplies and product or process surfaces." Explain the correct positioning principle when working at a unidirectional airflow (LAF) workstation, and why violating it causes contamination.

blocks.zh: Q2： C.8 強調「personnel initiatives」和互相提醒。在強調紀律的無菌製造環境中，如何建立一個員工願意主動回報問題（Safety Culture / Speak-up Culture）的管理文化？
blocks.en: Q2: C.8 stresses "personnel initiatives" and reminding one another. In an aseptic manufacturing environment that emphasizes discipline, how can you build a management culture (Safety Culture / Speak-up Culture) in which employees are willing to report problems proactively?

blocks.zh: Q3： 請比較「更衣程序驗證（Gowning Qualification）」和「更衣媒體填充試驗（Gowning Media Fill）」的目的和設計差異。
blocks.en: Q3: Compare the purpose and design differences between gowning qualification and a gowning media fill.

blocks.zh: C.4 健康狀況管理：什麼情況不能進入無菌室？
blocks.en: C.4 Health Status Management: When Must Personnel Not Enter the Aseptic Room?

blocks.zh: C.4 和 EU GMP Annex 1 §4.4 的健康規範實務比較：
blocks.en: A practical comparison of the health rules in C.4 and EU GMP Annex 1 §4.4:

blocks.zh: 實務上，許多製藥廠要求員工每日進入前填寫「Health Declaration（健康聲明）」，主動申報可能增加污染的健康狀況。
blocks.en: In practice, many pharmaceutical plants require employees to complete a "Health Declaration" before entering each day, proactively reporting any health condition that could increase contamination.

blocks.zh: Annex D (Informative) — Stationary Equipment 靜止設備詳細指南
blocks.en: Annex D (Informative) - Stationary Equipment: Detailed Guidance

blocks.zh: Annex D 深度解析
blocks.en: Annex D In-Depth Analysis

blocks.zh: 設備進場程序：「分層剝除法」的邏輯
blocks.en: Equipment Entry Procedure: The Logic of the "Layer-by-Layer Stripping" Method

blocks.zh: D.2.3 的分層拆包程序是設備進場的核心技術，其邏輯與物料的雙層包裝進場完全相同：
blocks.en: The layered unpacking procedure in D.2.3 is the core technique for equipment entry, and its logic is exactly the same as double-wrapped material entry:

blocks.zh: 原則：每去除一層包裝，就前進到下一個更潔淨的區域
blocks.en: Principle: each time a layer of packaging is removed, advance to the next cleaner area

blocks.zh: 方向：由外到內（非管制區 → 移行室 → 無塵室）
blocks.en: Direction: from outside to inside (uncontrolled area → transfer room → cleanroom)

blocks.zh: 清潔方向：由上到下（防止上方污染落到下方已清潔表面）
blocks.en: Cleaning direction: from top to bottom (to prevent contamination from above falling onto surfaces already cleaned below)

blocks.zh: 真空 + 擦拭組合：先真空吸除大顆粒，再濕擦去除附著污染
blocks.en: Combined vacuum + wipe: first vacuum off large particles, then wipe with a damp wipe to remove adhering contamination

blocks.zh: D.4 安裝期間隔離：GMP 的「在製品保護」原則
blocks.en: D.4 Isolation During Installation: The GMP Principle of "Protecting Work in Process"

blocks.zh: 在正在生產的無塵室中安裝設備，最大挑戰是：如何在施工產生污染的同時保護在製品？
blocks.en: The biggest challenge when installing equipment in a cleanroom that is in production: how to protect work in process while the construction generates contamination?

blocks.zh: 臨時隔離牆（temporary isolation wall）：搭建密封隔離區，將施工產生的污染限制在局部
blocks.en: Temporary isolation wall: build a sealed isolation zone to confine construction-generated contamination locally

blocks.zh: 負壓隔離區：隔離區維持負壓，確保污染不向外擴散到相鄰無塵室
blocks.en: Negative-pressure isolation zone: the isolation zone is kept at negative pressure to ensure contamination does not spread outward to adjacent cleanrooms

blocks.zh: 監測計畫（D.4.c）：隔離區外部需持續環境監測，確認污染未洩漏
blocks.en: Monitoring plan (D.4.c): environmental monitoring must continue outside the isolation zone to confirm that contamination has not leaked

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 §7.4：在無菌製造區附近進行施工，必須有書面的污染控制計畫，經 QA 批准
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 §7.4: construction near an aseptic manufacturing area must have a written contamination control plan approved by QA

blocks.zh: 比喻：設備安裝隔離如同「無菌手術中更換手術室設備」
blocks.en: Analogy: equipment installation isolation is like "replacing operating room equipment during aseptic surgery"

blocks.zh: 想像在心臟手術進行時，需要更換手術室的某台大型設備——顯然不可能。但某些工廠確實有「持續生產」的壓力，這時臨時隔離牆就是「在手術室一角搭起無菌簾幕」的工業版。D.4 的指導原則正是幫助工廠在這種高難度情境下維持污染控制。
blocks.en: Imagine that during heart surgery a large piece of equipment in the operating room has to be replaced: obviously impossible. But some plants really are under pressure to keep producing, and in that case the temporary isolation wall is the industrial version of "hanging a sterile curtain in one corner of the operating room". The guiding principles of D.4 help plants maintain contamination control in this difficult situation.

blocks.zh: 設備維護後的污染驗證
blocks.en: Contamination Verification After Equipment Maintenance

blocks.zh:
設備維護/修理後的清潔驗證程序：

維護後清潔流程：
1. 移除所有工具、備用件、廢棄物
2. 真空清潔設備外表面（由上到下）
3. 擦拭設備外表面（IPA 或指定消毒劑）
4. 擦拭設備內表面（如可進入）
5. 擦拭鄰近地板/牆面

驗證確認項目：
• 目視檢查（Visual inspection）：無可見污染
• 擦拭採樣（Wipe sampling）：微粒計數
• 微生物採樣（Microbial sampling）：biocleanroom 必做
• 粒子計數（Particle count）：確認環境恢復到操作前水平

文件記錄：
• 維護記錄（Maintenance log）
• 清潔記錄（Cleaning record）
• 監測結果（Monitoring results）
• QA 放行簽核
blocks.en:
Cleaning verification procedure after equipment maintenance/repair:

Post-maintenance cleaning flow:
1. Remove all tools, spare parts, and waste
2. Vacuum the external surfaces of the equipment (top to bottom)
3. Wipe the external surfaces of the equipment (IPA or the designated disinfectant)
4. Wipe the internal surfaces of the equipment (if accessible)
5. Wipe adjacent floors/walls

Verification items:
• Visual inspection: no visible contamination
• Wipe sampling: particle count
• Microbial sampling: mandatory for a biocleanroom
• Particle count: confirm that the environment has returned to its pre-operation level

Documentation:
• Maintenance log
• Cleaning record
• Monitoring results
• QA release sign-off

blocks.zh: Q1： 依 Annex D，如果一台填充機的核心機構需要在 Grade B 生產環境下進行緊急維修，請設計一個污染控制計畫，包含人員管理、隔離措施、監測和清潔驗證步驟。
blocks.en: Q1: Under Annex D, if the core mechanism of a filling machine needs emergency repair in a Grade B production environment, design a contamination control plan covering personnel management, isolation measures, monitoring, and cleaning verification steps.

blocks.zh: Q2： D.6 提到設備移除時可能攪動沉積污染。請說明何時需要對被移除的設備進行「pre-decontamination（移除前除污）」？在什麼情況下這是法規要求（而非僅是建議）？
blocks.en: Q2: D.6 mentions that removing equipment may disturb settled contamination. When is "pre-decontamination" of the equipment to be removed required? In what circumstances is it a regulatory requirement (rather than merely a recommendation)?

blocks.zh: Annex E (Informative) — Materials and Portable Equipment 物料與可攜式設備詳細指南
blocks.en: Annex E (Informative) - Materials and Portable Equipment: Detailed Guidance

blocks.zh: Annex E 深度解析
blocks.en: Annex E In-Depth Analysis

blocks.zh: E.2 物料選擇標準：無塵室相容性評估
blocks.en: E.2 Material Selection Criteria: Cleanroom Compatibility Assessment

blocks.zh: E.2 的選擇標準為物料採購提供了技術框架。在製藥無塵室的物料選擇實務中，通常需要評估：
blocks.en: The selection criteria in E.2 provide a technical framework for material procurement. In practice, selecting materials for a pharmaceutical cleanroom usually requires evaluating:

blocks.zh: 微粒脫落（Particle shedding）：材料表面的微粒脫落率，影響無塵室的潔淨等級
blocks.en: Particle shedding: the particle shedding rate of the material surface, which affects the cleanliness grade of the cleanroom

blocks.zh: 可萃出物（Extractables）/ 可浸出物（Leachables）：材料在清潔劑或產品接觸下可能釋出的化學物質，對注射劑和細胞治療產品特別重要
blocks.en: Extractables / leachables: chemicals the material may release on contact with cleaning agents or product, which is especially important for injectables and cell therapy products

blocks.zh: 靜電特性：在半導體廠是關鍵；在注射劑填充中，靜電可能吸附微粒到玻璃容器
blocks.en: Electrostatic properties: critical in semiconductor plants; in injectable filling, static electricity can attract particles onto glass containers

blocks.zh: 滅菌相容性：材料是否能耐受高壓蒸汽/γ照射/EO等滅菌方式
blocks.en: Sterilization compatibility: whether the material can withstand sterilization methods such as autoclave/gamma irradiation/EO

blocks.zh: 化學相容性：材料是否能耐受 IPA、H₂O₂ VHP 等常用消毒劑
blocks.en: Chemical compatibility: whether the material can withstand common disinfectants such as IPA and H₂O₂ VHP

blocks.zh: E.3 供應商變更通知的法規重要性
blocks.en: E.3 Regulatory Importance of Supplier Change Notification

blocks.zh: E.3 特別提到：「The supplier should notify the customer prior to making critical changes to approved materials.」這對應製藥業的：
blocks.en: E.3 specifically states: "The supplier should notify the customer prior to making critical changes to approved materials." This corresponds to the following in the pharmaceutical industry:

blocks.zh: 供應商審計（Supplier Audit）：確認供應商有變更通知的機制
blocks.en: Supplier audit: confirm that the supplier has a change notification mechanism

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 §2.7：供應商管理（Supplier Management）是藥品品質管理系統的要素之一
blocks.en: ICH Q10 §2.7: Supplier Management is one of the elements of the pharmaceutical quality system

blocks.zh: EU GMP Part 1 §7：合格供應商清單（Approved Suppliers List）和物料採購控制的要求
blocks.en: EU GMP Part 1 §7: requirements for the Approved Suppliers List and control of material purchasing

blocks.zh: 供應商未通知變更而導致物料規格改變，是製藥法規中常見的重大合規問題（可能影響產品上市許可）
blocks.en: A change in material specification caused by a supplier failing to give notice of a change is a common major compliance problem in pharmaceutical regulation (and may affect the marketing authorization)

blocks.zh: 無塵室擦拭布（Wiper）選擇決策矩陣
blocks.en: Cleanroom Wiper Selection Decision Matrix

blocks.zh:
不同應用的 Wiper 選擇指南（依 E.5.4）：

應用場景          | 建議材質          | 關鍵特性
───────────────────────────────────────────────
Grade A 表面清潔  | 聚酯纖維編織      | 低微粒、低萃出物、滅菌相容
Grade B 表面清潔  | 聚酯/尼龍混紡     | 低微粒、吸液性好
Grade C 地板清潔  | 聚酯纖維拖把頭    | 耐IPA/消毒劑、可高壓蒸汽
玻璃/不鏽鋼精密面 | 無塵乾拭布        | 低粒子、不留纖維
設備外表面        | 聚酯/尼龍         | 吸液快、耐溶劑
溢漏應急清潔      | 高吸液超吸水材    | 快速吸收，防二次擴散

禁止在無塵室使用：
• 棉質抹布（高脫屑）
• 紙巾（大量脫屑和纖維）
• 一般海綿（不可高壓蒸汽，且脫落顆粒）
blocks.en:
Wiper selection guide for different applications (per E.5.4):

Application            | Suggested material       | Key characteristics
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Grade A surface cleaning | Knitted polyester        | Low particles, low extractables, sterilization compatible
Grade B surface cleaning | Polyester/nylon blend    | Low particles, good liquid absorption
Grade C floor cleaning   | Polyester mop head       | IPA/disinfectant resistant, autoclavable
Glass/stainless steel precision surfaces | Dry cleanroom wipe | Low particles, no fiber residue
Equipment external surfaces | Polyester/nylon      | Fast absorption, solvent resistant
Spill emergency cleaning | High-absorbency superabsorbent material | Rapid absorption, prevents secondary spread

Prohibited in the cleanroom:
• Cotton rags (high shedding)
• Paper towels (heavy shedding and fibers)
• Ordinary sponges (not autoclavable, and shed particles)

blocks.zh: 比喻：E.4.1 物料進場如同外科手術包的傳遞
blocks.en: Analogy: E.4.1 material entry is like passing a surgical pack

blocks.zh: 手術器械從污染區（外部）→ 滅菌室 → 傳遞窗（Transfer Window）→ 手術室（清潔區），每個環節都有嚴格的包裝剝除程序。物料進入無塵室的程序完全相同邏輯：紙箱在倉庫移除、IPA 擦拭在移行室進行、最內層包裝到使用前才剝除。任何「跳步」都等同於「帶著污染外包裝直接進入手術室」。
blocks.en: Surgical instruments move from the contaminated area (outside) → sterilization room → transfer window → operating room (clean area), with a strict packaging-removal procedure at each step. The procedure for materials entering a cleanroom follows exactly the same logic: cartons are removed in the warehouse, IPA wiping is done in the transfer room, and the innermost packaging is removed only just before use. Any "skipped step" is equivalent to "carrying a contaminated outer package straight into the operating room".

blocks.zh: E.5.16 文件管理在無塵室的特殊要求
blocks.en: E.5.16 Special Documentation Requirements in a Cleanroom

blocks.zh: 一個常被忽視的細節：紙張（paper）是無塵室的重要污染源！E.5.16 的要求：
blocks.en: A frequently overlooked detail: paper is an important contamination source in a cleanroom! The requirements of E.5.16:

blocks.zh: 普通紙張禁止帶入高等級無塵室（脫落纖維 + 脫落塗料）
blocks.en: Ordinary paper must not be brought into high-grade cleanrooms (shed fibers + shed coating)

blocks.zh: 可使用：無塵紙（lint-free paper）、熱塑性薄膜覆蓋（thermally laminated）
blocks.en: Permitted: lint-free paper, thermally laminated sheets

blocks.zh: 書寫工具：避免鉛筆（石墨粉末）、橡皮擦、毛氈筆（揮發性有機物）；使用非縮頭式圓珠筆
blocks.en: Writing instruments: avoid pencils (graphite powder), erasers, and felt-tip pens (volatile organic compounds); use non-retractable ballpoint pens

blocks.zh: 最佳方案：電子化紀錄系統（E.5.17）——將批次記錄、設備日誌電子化，消除紙張污染問題
blocks.en: Best solution: electronic record systems (E.5.17), digitizing batch records and equipment logs to eliminate paper contamination

blocks.zh: 在 Grade A/B 核心區：通常禁止任何形式的紙張文件，改用電子化系統（如平板電腦＋防護膜）
blocks.en: In the Grade A/B core area: paper documents in any form are generally prohibited, and electronic systems (such as tablets with protective film) are used instead

blocks.zh: Q1： 一家 CDMO 準備評估一種新的「可重複使用聚酯拖把頭」用於 Grade B 走廊清潔。依 Annex E，應進行哪些評估測試？請列出評估項目和合格標準。
blocks.en: Q1: A CDMO is preparing to evaluate a new "reusable polyester mop head" for cleaning a Grade B corridor. Under Annex E, what evaluation tests should be performed? List the evaluation items and acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: Q2： E.5.17 說明電腦鍵盤的「縫隙」可能成為微粒陷阱。在高等級無塵室中，如何解決電子設備（電腦、平板、條碼掃描器）的使用和清潔管理問題？
blocks.en: Q2: E.5.17 notes that the "gaps" in a computer keyboard can become particle traps. In a high-grade cleanroom, how should the use and cleaning of electronic devices (computers, tablets, barcode scanners) be managed?

blocks.zh: Q3： 依 E.3 關於供應商管理的要求，如果你的拖把頭供應商通知材質從 PVA 變更為聚酯，作為 QA 主管你應採取哪些行動？
blocks.en: Q3: Under the E.3 requirements for supplier management, if your mop head supplier notifies you that the material is changing from PVA to polyester, what actions should you take as QA head?

blocks.zh: Annex F (Informative) — Cleanroom Cleaning 無塵室清潔詳細指南
blocks.en: Annex F (Informative) - Cleanroom Cleaning: Detailed Guidance

blocks.zh: Annex F 深度解析
blocks.en: Annex F In-Depth Analysis

blocks.zh: 法規連結：PDA TR70 與 EU GMP Annex 1 消毒要求
blocks.en: Regulatory Link: PDA TR70 and EU GMP Annex 1 Disinfection Requirements

blocks.zh: PDA Technical Report No. 70 的核心要求對應 F.5.3：
blocks.en: The core requirements of PDA Technical Report No. 70 correspond to F.5.3:

blocks.zh: 消毒劑輪替（Disinfectant Rotation）：至少兩種作用機制不同的消毒劑輪替，防止耐藥性。例如：QAC（季銨鹽）與 IPA 輪替；或 QAC 與次氯酸鈉輪替
blocks.en: Disinfectant Rotation: rotate at least two disinfectants with different mechanisms of action to prevent resistance. For example: QAC (quaternary ammonium compound) alternating with IPA, or QAC alternating with sodium hypochlorite

blocks.zh: 定期孢子殺菌劑使用（Sporicidal Agent）：如過氧乙酸（PAA）、氯基消毒劑，定期（如每週或每月）使用，覆蓋細菌孢子
blocks.en: Periodic use of a sporicidal agent: such as peracetic acid (PAA) or chlorine-based disinfectants, used regularly (for example weekly or monthly) to cover bacterial spores

blocks.zh: 消毒劑效力驗證：針對廠內環境中分離到的菌種進行 in-house efficacy testing
blocks.en: Disinfectant efficacy validation: perform in-house efficacy testing against the strains isolated from the facility environment

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 §4.34：消毒程序需驗證其有效性；§4.35：至少每年確認一次消毒劑效力
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 §4.34: disinfection procedures must be validated for effectiveness; §4.35: disinfectant efficacy must be confirmed at least once a year

blocks.zh: F.5.3 的接觸時間（Contact Time）：消毒劑必須與表面保持足夠的接觸時間（通常 ≥ 5-10 分鐘）才能達到殺菌效果，「快速擦拭」是無效的
blocks.en: Contact time in F.5.3: the disinfectant must remain in contact with the surface for sufficient time (generally ≥ 5-10 minutes) to achieve a bactericidal effect; a "quick wipe" is ineffective

blocks.zh: 消毒劑效力的四個決定因素（F.5.3）
blocks.en: The Four Determinants of Disinfectant Efficacy (F.5.3)

blocks.zh:
消毒效力 = f(Type, Concentration, Temperature, Contact Time)

消毒效力的四個決定因素：
1. 消毒劑種類（Type）：
   • IPA 70%：對細菌/真菌有效，對孢子無效
   • QAC（如 Benzalkonium chloride）：廣譜，但抗性問題
   • 次氯酸鈉（Bleach）：廣譜含孢子；腐蝕性強
   • 過氧乙酸（PAA）：廣譜含孢子；分解快、殘留低
   • H₂O₂ VHP：廣譜含孢子；適合空間消毒

2. 濃度（Concentration）：
   • 太低：殺菌不足
   • 太高：毒性/殘留/材料損傷

3. 溫度（Temperature）：
   • 通常溫度越高，殺菌效率越好
   • 冷藏環境需特別考慮

4. 接觸時間（Contact Time）：
   • 最關鍵！必須保持濕潤至少規定時間
   • 「塗抹後立即擦乾」= 無效消毒
blocks.en:
Disinfection efficacy = f(Type, Concentration, Temperature, Contact Time)

The four determinants of disinfection efficacy:
1. Type of disinfectant:
   • IPA 70%: effective against bacteria/fungi, not against spores
   • QAC (e.g. benzalkonium chloride): broad spectrum, but resistance issues
   • Sodium hypochlorite (bleach): broad spectrum including spores; highly corrosive
   • Peracetic acid (PAA): broad spectrum including spores; breaks down quickly, low residue
   • H₂O₂ VHP: broad spectrum including spores; suited to space disinfection

2. Concentration:
   • Too low: insufficient kill
   • Too high: toxicity/residue/material damage

3. Temperature:
   • Generally, the higher the temperature, the better the kill efficiency
   • Cold environments need special consideration

4. Contact time:
   • The most critical! The surface must stay wet for at least the specified time
   • "Wipe dry immediately after applying" = ineffective disinfection

blocks.zh: 比喻：F.3.5 單向擦拭如同醫療傷口清潔
blocks.en: Analogy: F.3.5 unidirectional wiping is like cleaning a medical wound

blocks.zh: 清潔傷口的正確方式：從傷口中心向外擦拭（防止外部污染帶入傷口），且每次擦拭後更換棉球（防止重複污染）。無塵室 Precision Cleaning 的單向擦拭邏輯相同：從最關鍵區域向外擦，擦布折疊出新面繼續擦，用完即丟。
blocks.en: The correct way to clean a wound: wipe outward from the center of the wound (to prevent external contamination being carried into it), and change the cotton ball after each wipe (to prevent repeated contamination). The logic of unidirectional wiping in cleanroom precision cleaning is the same: wipe outward from the most critical area, fold the wiper to expose a fresh face and continue, and discard it after use.

blocks.zh: F.9 十階段建設期清潔計畫的意義
blocks.en: The Significance of the F.9 Ten-Stage Construction Cleaning Plan

blocks.zh: Table F.1 的10個階段清潔計畫是新建無塵室「progressive cleaning」的標準框架。每個階段的清潔標準從 Visual-clean 逐步提升到 Wiper-clean，確保在HEPA過濾器安裝前，已逐步去除施工污染。
blocks.en: The 10-stage cleaning plan in Table F.1 is the standard framework for "progressive cleaning" of a newly built cleanroom. The cleanliness standard at each stage rises gradually from visual-clean to wiper-clean, ensuring that construction contamination has been progressively removed before the HEPA filters are installed.

blocks.zh: 關鍵轉折點 Stage 5-6：在安裝 HEPA/ULPA 過濾器前，必須達到 wiper-clean 標準，防止施工污染損壞或堵塞過濾器
blocks.en: Key turning point, Stages 5-6: before installing HEPA/ULPA filters, the wiper-clean standard must be reached, to prevent construction contamination from damaging or clogging the filters

blocks.zh: Stage 7 Air Flushing：開啟空調系統「吹洗」，利用空氣流動帶走懸浮污染
blocks.en: Stage 7 Air Flushing: turn on the air handling system to "flush" the room, using airflow to carry away airborne contamination

blocks.zh: Stage 9 Certification：正式的分類認證測試，包含粒子計數、氣流速度、溫濕度、壓差
blocks.en: Stage 9 Certification: the formal classification certification tests, including particle count, air velocity, temperature and humidity, and pressure differential

blocks.zh: Stage 10：進入日常清潔模式，此時 biocleanroom 開始建立微生物基線數據
blocks.en: Stage 10: enter the routine cleaning mode; at this point the biocleanroom begins to build its microbiological baseline data

blocks.zh: 清潔 SOP 的「紀錄與驗證」要求
blocks.en: "Record and Verification" Requirements for Cleaning SOPs

blocks.zh: F.7 的 11 步清潔計畫和 F.8 的監測要求，對應製藥業的清潔 SOP 文件標準：
blocks.en: The 11-step cleaning program in F.7 and the monitoring requirements in F.8 correspond to the documentation standards for pharmaceutical cleaning SOPs:

blocks.zh: 清潔記錄（Cleaning Log）：每次清潔後立即填寫，記錄：日期時間、人員、使用消毒劑（批號、濃度）、清潔區域、結果
blocks.en: Cleaning Log: completed immediately after each cleaning, recording date and time, personnel, disinfectant used (lot number, concentration), area cleaned, and result

blocks.zh: 環境監測整合：清潔後的 EM 採樣結果是驗證清潔有效性的直接證據
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring integration: EM sampling results after cleaning are direct evidence that cleaning is effective

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析（Trend Analysis）：長期環境監測數據的統計分析，識別清潔有效性下降的早期信號
blocks.en: Trend Analysis: statistical analysis of long-term environmental monitoring data to identify early signals of declining cleaning effectiveness

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證（Cleaning Validation）：證明清潔 SOP 能重複有效地達到預定潔淨標準，需以實驗數據支撐
blocks.en: Cleaning Validation: demonstrates that the cleaning SOP repeatedly and effectively achieves the predetermined cleanliness standard, and must be supported by experimental data

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用情境：建立 Grade B/C 清潔消毒 SOP 體系
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Establishing a Grade B/C Cleaning and Disinfection SOP System

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 的 Grade B 無菌填充間需要建立清潔消毒體系，依 Annex F 規劃：
blocks.en: Your CDMO's Grade B aseptic filling room needs a cleaning and disinfection system; plan it according to Annex F:

blocks.zh: F.2 表面分類：填充機台 = Critical；工作台面 = Critical；牆面/地板 = General；更衣室 = 高頻率清潔
blocks.en: F.2 Surface classification: filling machine = Critical; work surfaces = Critical; walls/floors = General; changing room = high-frequency cleaning

blocks.zh: F.7.3 頻率計畫：Critical 表面每批次生產前後清潔；General 每日清潔；更衣室每日多次（每班）
blocks.en: F.7.3 Frequency plan: Critical surfaces are cleaned before and after each production batch; General surfaces daily; the changing room several times a day (every shift)

blocks.zh: 消毒劑輪替（PDA TR70）：平日 IPA 70% → 每週 QAC → 每月 PAA（孢子殺菌劑）；確認所有消毒劑已對廠內菌株驗證效力
blocks.en: Disinfectant rotation (PDA TR70): IPA 70% on ordinary days → QAC weekly → PAA (sporicidal agent) monthly; confirm that all disinfectants have been validated for efficacy against in-house isolates

blocks.zh: F.8 監測計畫：清潔後粒子計數 + 微生物 contact plates（5個關鍵點/每批），結果納入 EM Program 趨勢分析
blocks.en: F.8 Monitoring plan: particle counts after cleaning + microbial contact plates (5 critical points per batch), with results included in the EM Program trend analysis

blocks.zh: F.6 清潔人員培訓：專用培訓課程，涵蓋單向擦拭技術、消毒劑使用、正確更衣
blocks.en: F.6 Cleaning personnel training: a dedicated training course covering unidirectional wiping technique, disinfectant use, and correct gowning

blocks.zh: Q1： F.4.3 說明在單向氣流無塵室中，上游表面不能在 operational 狀態下清潔。請解釋其原因，並說明什麼情況下必須在 operational 狀態清潔（例如溢漏事件），此時應採取哪些保護措施？
blocks.en: Q1: F.4.3 states that in a unidirectional airflow cleanroom, upstream surfaces must not be cleaned in the operational state. Explain why, and describe when cleaning in the operational state is unavoidable (for example, a spill event) and what protective measures should then be taken.

blocks.zh: Q2： 消毒劑輪替（Disinfectant Rotation）的目的是什麼？請設計一個 Grade B 無菌填充間的消毒劑輪替計畫，包括消毒劑選擇依據和輪替頻率。
blocks.en: Q2: What is the purpose of disinfectant rotation? Design a disinfectant rotation plan for a Grade B aseptic filling room, including the basis for choosing disinfectants and the rotation frequency.

blocks.zh: Q3： Table F.1 的 Stage 10 說明 biocleanroom 需「Microbiological cleaning and testing begins」。請說明新建無菌製造廠在 Stage 10 啟動時，如何建立微生物環境監測的基線數據（baseline），並設定初始 Alert Level 和 Action Level？
blocks.en: Q3: Stage 10 of Table F.1 states that a biocleanroom requires "Microbiological cleaning and testing begins". When a newly built aseptic manufacturing plant starts Stage 10, how should it establish baseline microbiological environmental monitoring data and set the initial Alert Level and Action Level?

blocks.en: Three Levels of Cleaning: Strategies for Different Areas and Surfaces
