blocks.zh: 綜合總結 — Key Takeaways & Regulatory Connections
blocks.en: Summary - Key Takeaways & Regulatory Connections

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-5:2004 整合回顧與法規應用
blocks.en: ISO 14644-5:2004 Integrated Review and Regulatory Application

blocks.zh: 最終學習重點與法規連結
blocks.en: Final Learning Points and Regulatory Connections

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-5 的最重要原則
blocks.en: The Most Important Principles of ISO 14644-5

blocks.zh: 學習完本文件，最重要的三個核心原則：
blocks.en: After studying this document, the three most important core principles are:

blocks.zh: 人員是最大污染源：所有六大操作系統中，人員（服裝 + 行為 + 健康）的控制是最關鍵的，也是最難完全量化和控制的
blocks.en: People are the biggest source of contamination: among all six operational systems, controlling personnel (clothing + behavior + health) is the most critical, and also the hardest to fully quantify and control

blocks.zh: 預防勝於治療：preventive maintenance（預防性維護）、定期清潔、定期服裝更換，都體現「在污染發生前就控制」的原則
blocks.en: Prevention is better than cure: preventive maintenance, regular cleaning, and regular garment replacement all embody the principle of "controlling before contamination occurs"

blocks.zh: 系統化、文件化：所有程序必須書面化、可追溯、可稽查——這不只是法規要求，更是確保一致性的基礎
blocks.en: Systematic and documented: all procedures must be written down, traceable, and auditable; this is not only a regulatory requirement but the basis for ensuring consistency

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-5 在製藥法規框架中的定位
blocks.en: Position of ISO 14644-5 in the Pharmaceutical Regulatory Framework

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-5 是通用無塵室操作標準，在製藥體系中的定位：
blocks.en: ISO 14644-5 is a general cleanroom operating standard; its position within the pharmaceutical system:

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-5 = 通用基礎框架（適用所有行業）
blocks.en: ISO 14644-5 = general foundational framework (applicable to all industries)

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 = 製藥無菌製造的強制規範（比 ISO 14644-5 更嚴）
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 = mandatory requirements for pharmaceutical aseptic manufacturing (stricter than ISO 14644-5)

blocks.zh: FDA Aseptic Processing Guide = FDA 的無菌製造指南（與 EU GMP Annex 1 高度對齊）
blocks.en: FDA Aseptic Processing Guide = FDA guidance for aseptic manufacturing (closely aligned with EU GMP Annex 1)

blocks.zh: PDA TR70 = 清潔消毒的技術詳細指南（補充 Annex F 的不足）
blocks.en: PDA TR70 = detailed technical guidance on cleaning and disinfection (fills the gaps of Annex F)

blocks.zh: ICH Q9/Q10 = 風險管理和品質系統的跨行業框架（與 Annex A 互補）
blocks.en: ICH Q9/Q10 = cross-industry framework for risk management and quality systems (complements Annex A)

blocks.zh: 實務上，製藥廠需要同時符合以上所有相關規範，並以最嚴格的要求為標準。
blocks.en: In practice, pharmaceutical plants must comply with all of the relevant requirements above at the same time, using the strictest as the standard.

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-5 六大操作系統的污染貢獻排名（概念性）
blocks.en: Contamination Contribution Ranking of the Six ISO 14644-5 Operational Systems (Conceptual)

blocks.zh:
污染風險由高至低（概念排序，不代表所有情況）：

1. 人員行為 (Section 4.3, Annex C.6)
   → 最動態、最難控制；快速走動、不良站位等

2. 人員服裝缺陷 (Section 4.2, Annex B)
   → 更衣錯誤、服裝破損、服裝超期未更換

3. 清潔不足 (Section 4.6, Annex F)
   → 清潔頻率不足、方法不正確、消毒劑選擇錯誤

4. 物料進場帶入 (Section 4.5, Annex E)
   → 未去除外包裝直接進場

5. 設備維護失當 (Section 4.4, Annex D)
   → 未進行預防性維護、維修後未清潔

6. 系統文件缺陷 (Section 4.1, Annex A)
   → SOP 不完整、培訓不足、缺乏變更控制
blocks.en:
Contamination risk from high to low (conceptual ranking; does not apply to every situation):

1. Personnel behavior (Section 4.3, Annex C.6)
   → the most dynamic and hardest to control; fast movement, poor positioning, etc.

2. Garment deficiencies (Section 4.2, Annex B)
   → gowning errors, damaged garments, garments not replaced after expiry

3. Inadequate cleaning (Section 4.6, Annex F)
   → insufficient cleaning frequency, incorrect methods, wrong disinfectant choice

4. Material entry (Section 4.5, Annex E)
   → outer packaging not removed before entry

5. Improper equipment maintenance (Section 4.4, Annex D)
   → no preventive maintenance, no cleaning after repair

6. System documentation deficiencies (Section 4.1, Annex A)
   → incomplete SOPs, insufficient training, no change control

blocks.zh: 綜合應用案例：新建 Grade B 無菌填充廠的操作系統設計
blocks.en: Integrated Case: Operational System Design for a New Grade B Aseptic Filling Plant

blocks.zh: 依 ISO 14644-5 全文，為一個新建的 Grade B 無菌填充廠設計操作系統：
blocks.en: Using the full text of ISO 14644-5, design the operational systems for a new Grade B aseptic filling plant:

blocks.zh: 4.1 操作系統：建立 SOP 架構（更衣、清潔、設備進場、EM、培訓、變更控制）；執行 FMEA 識別主要污染風險點
blocks.en: 4.1 Operational systems: establish the SOP structure (gowning, cleaning, equipment entry, EM, training, change control); perform an FMEA to identify the main contamination risk points

blocks.zh: 4.2 服裝體系：Grade B 選用可滅菌連身服；建立洗滌商 SOP 和資格管理；服裝效期管理和每次使用前目視檢查
blocks.en: 4.2 Garment system: sterilizable coveralls for Grade B; laundry provider SOP and qualification management; garment shelf-life management and visual inspection before each use

blocks.zh: 4.3 人員管理：全員基礎培訓 + 實操培訓；Gowning Qualification（每年複查）；每日健康聲明；禁止珠寶/化妝品
blocks.en: 4.3 Personnel management: basic training + hands-on training for all staff; Gowning Qualification (re-checked annually); daily health declaration; jewelry/cosmetics prohibited

blocks.zh: 4.4 設備管理：新設備分層清潔進場 SOP；PM 計畫表（每季/每年保養）；維修後清潔驗證程序
blocks.en: 4.4 Equipment management: SOP for layered cleaning of new equipment entry; PM schedule (quarterly/annual servicing); post-repair cleaning verification procedure

blocks.zh: 4.5 物料管理：雙層去包流程 SOP；無塵室內物料最小庫存原則；廢棄物每班清除
blocks.en: 4.5 Materials management: double-bag entry SOP; minimum inventory principle for materials in the cleanroom; waste removed every shift

blocks.zh: 4.6 清潔管理：表面分類清潔計畫（Critical vs. General）；消毒劑輪替計畫；清潔後 EM 確認（粒子 + 微生物）
blocks.en: 4.6 Cleaning management: surface-classified cleaning plan (Critical vs. General); disinfectant rotation plan; EM confirmation after cleaning (particles + microorganisms)

blocks.en: Comprehensive Review Questions

blocks.zh: Q1： 一個 FDA 稽查員來稽查你的 Grade B 無菌填充廠。他/她最可能查閱哪些文件？請列出 10 項應備齊的關鍵文件（涵蓋 ISO 14644-5 的六大操作系統）。
blocks.en: Q1: An FDA inspector comes to inspect your Grade B aseptic filling plant. Which documents is he or she most likely to review? List 10 key documents that should be in place (covering the six operational systems of ISO 14644-5).

blocks.zh: Q2： 環境監測結果顯示，Grade B 走廊的微生物監測連續兩週出現超 Alert Level 的結果，但未超 Action Level。請依 ISO 14644-5 Annex A.3 和 EU GMP Annex 1 §9 的要求，設計一個系統性調查計畫。
blocks.en: Q2: Environmental monitoring results show that microbial monitoring in the Grade B corridor has exceeded the Alert Level for two consecutive weeks, but has not exceeded the Action Level. Based on ISO 14644-5 Annex A.3 and EU GMP Annex 1 §9, design a systematic investigation plan.

blocks.zh: Q3： 試分析「更衣室設計不良（無 cross-over bench）」如何連鎖影響 ISO 14644-5 六大操作系統的風險，並提出改善方案。
blocks.en: Q3: Analyze how "poor changing room design (no cross-over bench)" has a cascading effect on the risks of the six ISO 14644-5 operational systems, and propose an improvement plan.
